name: WARNING: Nongshim Shin Ramyun Spicy Instant Noodles
whyItWorks: Deep-fried flash-dehydrated noodle cake accompanied by a fierce red chili powder soup base with dried garlic, scallions, and intense capsaicin extract. Triggers extreme chemical burning, mucosal spasms, and acute watery diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Strictly avoid spicy instant ramen packets. If craving ramen, choose plain unspiced rice noodles in clear bone broth.
